xaqda4mj.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Ultra-Lit Montagna Fir Micro LED Tree
xaqda4mj.sourceDescription: This is one for the Yuletide fanatics! If you're serious about having the most realistic 7ft artificial Christmas tree this year, then hey presto you've found it. A top-of-the-line tree you'll be showing off for years to come, the Montagna has myriad impressive qualities. Along with the extremely full and bushy foliage, this Ultra-Lit Montagna comes with a fantastic array of pre-attached 'micro' LEDs. These are smaller than normal lights and provide a brighter, more dazzling display. Best of all, this 7ft pre-lit Xmas tree is powered by the trunk slotting together. This unique tree lighting system not only assembly much simpler, but it also helps to keep cables out of sight. Picture shows 7ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. mg43qah2.baseName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
mg43qah2.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
mg43qah2.sourceDescription: Bring a warm festive glow to your home with the stunning 7ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine. This beautifully full artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 480 multi-function warm white LED lights, creating a charming centrepiece for your Christmas celebrations. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. There is plenty of foliage to showcase your favourite decorations. We love its gently upswept branches and classic, tapered shape, with natural shades of green and subtle brown detailing adding character throughout. The warm white LED lights highlight the texture of the needles, while their multi-function settings let you choose the lighting effect to suit your festive display. The tree comes in three sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. For the best results, spread the inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 7ft • Pre-lit: 480 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 1,800 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree width: 120cm diameter • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches and three tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 60cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Carton dimensions: 118cm × 38cm × 42cm • Weight: 20kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

jvn8j4w3.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Compact Base - White - 150 cm
jvn8j4w3.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Compact Base - White - 150 cm
jvn8j4w3.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree with LED is designed to bring the spirit of the festive season into your home with its sleek and modern appearance. Its cone-shaped design and dynamic LED light show make it a stunning centerpiece for your seasonal decor, perfect for creating a winter wonderland in both indoor and sheltered outdoor spaces. Crafted from abrasion-resistant materials like PVC and steel, this tree provides a durable and lasting addition to your holiday celebrations. Materials: This tree is crafted from PVC and steel, ensuring an abrasion-resistant and long-lasting build. The materials are selected to maintain their appearance over time, bringing joy year after year without wear. Included Components: It includes an LED string light with dynamic lighting patterns and a USB plug, making it easy to illuminate the space with vibrant lights. A sturdy steel stand is provided to keep the tree stable. Features /Function /Design: With eight LED flash modes, the lighting offers multiple visual experiences, from steady to dynamic displays, allowing you to customize the ambiance according to your mood or event. Recommended Uses: Suitable for the living room, garden, and terrace, this tree's versatility in design shines in any setting, enhancing the festive atmosphere wherever placed. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions using a screwdriver. The non-traditional USB plug offers a universal power source connection, ensuring easy setup and teardown. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 680 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Purple Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
